stage: source-first questions frozen before candidate vocabulary
independence: Same author had read current ontology and prior packet. Questions preceded this dossier's candidate construction, but are not independent held-out tests. Fresh external probes still required.

questions.text: What do residents value about this forest besides income?
Whose values were included when the fire-management options were compared?
questions.source_motivation: representation of valuations not universal value

questions.text: Is an estimate of market exchange value being mistaken for total importance?
questions.source_motivation: exchange versus welfare and other values

questions.text: What losses might a fire cause to people, assets and ways of life?
Which assets are exposed without necessarily being highly susceptible to damage?
How does a community express an attachment that it will not trade for money?
Could two reasonable assessors rank the same options differently?
Which observed damage changed the value assigned to a building?
questions.source_motivation: damage versus valuation revision, no automatic monetary conversion

questions.text: What level of risk is acceptable to whom, and under which stated criterion?
Did the ranking change after participants learned about downstream flood effects?
questions.source_motivation: valuation revision occurrence; causal mechanism remains model

questions.text: Are costs and benefits distributed to the same people?
questions.source_motivation: distribution cannot be inferred from aggregate value

questions.text: Is the quoted monetary amount an actual exchange, an accounting estimate or willingness to pay?
Was a site valued as replaceable, or as a relationship that cannot be substituted?
questions.source_motivation: substitutability is not identical to price

questions.text: What happened when the panel could not reach a common ranking?
Does an unresolved risk estimate mean the forest is safe?
questions.source_motivation: open-world unknown, not zero loss or absence of hazard
